affected.note: Customer records stored in the Beauty Garage and Eyelash Garage EC systems as of 2026-10-10 23:55. Addresses, purchase histories and payment data were not confirmed leaked. This is separate from the possible credit card data leak the company announced on 2026-02-06.

summary.en: Beauty Garage detected on 2026-10-13 that the server of its EC sites had been broken into between 2026-10-10 and 2026-10-12. 775,725 customer records, including company and salon names, customer names, phone numbers, email addresses and hashed passwords, leaked.
summary.ja: ビューティガレージは2026年10月13日、同社ECサイトのサーバーに10月10日から12日にかけて不正侵入されていたことを検知した。会社名、サロン名、氏名、電話番号、メールアドレス、パスワードのハッシュ値などを含む顧客情報775,725件が外部に流出した。
